name: Tokimeki Memorial 4 Mobile
original_name: ときめきメモリアル4 mobile
source: A spin-off of the original Tokimeki Memorial 4 developed specially for mobile devices. The story begins when the main character, who is about to graduate, reunites with his childhood friend and original heroine, Inokura Kiho, for the first time in three years.
